name: Battery
description: Battery level via UPower (hidden without a battery), low and critical battery notifications with an optional critical action, and a power panel: charge, time left, power draw, health, power profile and charge limit

low.description: Percentage at which the bar level turns urgent

warnAt.description: Percentage at which one low-battery notification is sent while discharging (1-100)

criticalAt.description: Percentage at which one critical notification is sent (0 = never; at most warnAt)

criticalAction.description: At criticalAt: none, suspend, hibernate or poweroff, run through haseen system 60 s after the critical notification unless its Cancel is pressed or a charger is plugged in

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.battery (state, cancel) from the service
